blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke foran baad 23.3.1 shuru karti hai. Is hisse mein do cheezen hain: 23.3.1 mein C=O group par nucleophilic addition reactions (HCN ka addition, hydride ion ka addition yani reduction, aur 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine ke saath addition-elimination), aur 23.3.2 mein woh tests jin se aldehydes aur ketones pehchane jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Nucleophile carbonyl compound ke kis hisse par hamla (attack) karta hai?
blocks.explanation: δ⁺ carbonyl carbon par, kyun ke oxygen electrons ko apni taraf kheench leta hai aur carbon electrons ka bhooka (electrophilic) reh jata hai.

items: 23.3.1: HCN, hydride ion (NaBH₄/LiAlH₄) aur 2,4-DNPH ke reactions.
